title: Study on selective adsorption of organic pollutants in environmental water samples by solid-phase microextraction based on MOF-derived coatings
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,37570-37578
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02456K, Paper
Open Access

Junliang Du, Juan Li, Ruiman Yin, Shiyu Liu, Ting Deng, Xinzhen Du
This work presents a facile strategy for the fabrication of novel cobalt-based coatings on NiTi fiber, enabling the selective preconcentration and determination of typical aromatic organic pollutants in environmental water samples.
